pages.title: The Gaze
pages.text: Eyeblossom · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Eyeblossom Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you.$(br2)— Friedrich Nietzsche, Beyond Good and Evil

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: All beings within 25 blocks glow; a straight stare pins them for 4s, then slows.$(br2)$(br2)Gaze 3:00
